sentences.text:
This Court has issued notice after recording the submission that respondent no.1-Nivisha Singh is serving in IMT,
Ghaziabad and residing at Ghaziabad.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the present transfer petition seeks transfer of Case No.23258 of 2022 (Complaint No.855 of 2022) file by the respondent, pending before the ACJM,
District Court Allahabad, Uttar Pradesh for offences punishable under Sections 498A, 313, 406, 326,
